mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tags (id, user_id, name, normalized_name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, btrim(#{name}), lower(btrim(#{name})), #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, normalized_name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT g.id FROM tags g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.normalized_name = lower(btrim(#{name})) AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT g.id, NULL::uuid AS todo_id, g.name FROM tags g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY g.normalized_name ASC, g.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_tags (todo_id, tag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{tagId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (todo_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
